name: compactOpen_eq_generateFrom
statement: Set (Set X)} {T : Set (Set Y)} (hS₁ : ∀ K ∈ S, IsCompact K) (hT : IsTopologicalBasis T) (hS₂ : ∀ f : C(X, Y), ∀ x, ∀ V ∈ T, f x ∈ V → ∃ K ∈ S, K ∈ 𝓝 x ∧ MapsTo f K V) : compactOpen = .generateFrom (.image2 (fun K t ↦ {f : C(X, Y) | MapsTo f K (⋃₀ t)}) S {t : Set (Set Y) | t.Finite ∧ t ⊆ T})
